central.grant_scope: Incremental route-conversion capital only. Common trolley replacement is excluded because the same electric renewal is required in the ordinary-renewal comparator.
central.grant_extension_note: grant_cases_with_common_trolley_capital applies a common-trolley grant only to the plan and is retained only as an intentionally asymmetric policy counterfactual. The symmetric_common_trolley case applies the same percentage to both comparator and plan.

boundaries: Vehicle prices come from public planning or external procurement envelopes and mix 2021--2026 nominal currencies; they are not rebased to a single bid year.
Shared heavy-bus depot investment is sized from 1419 heavy positions and retained once. Class-specific charger/site items are added separately, but site power and civil works may still overlap.
The double-deck annual distance is a weekday-share proxy; the shuttle distance is an independently published 2023 actual total.
Shuttle and double-deck manufacturing inventories include battery factors; the shuttle glider mass is not invented.
Depot construction and end-of-life are excluded from the environmental boundary.

The financial envelope excludes post-2023 battery replacement, retained pre-2024 asset terminal values, disposal proceeds and infrastructure terminal value; opposing omissions mean this is not a conservative bound or complete TCO.

warnings: Emission factors are not a 2023 Vancouver chassis/PEMS certification.
CNG service km is inferred from purchased-gas energy and an EEA energy-consumption factor.
The gasoline-shuttle factor is the BC legacy inventory bus factor; no newer BC bus factor was located.
The high PM and NOx diesel/hybrid values are a conservative legacy-fleet envelope from the BC inventory, not a claim about every 2023 bus.
PM exhaust is treated as having PM2.5 = PM10 = TSP in the EEA workbook; the BC legacy rows retain separate PM2.5 and PM10 columns.
The existing transition scenario's 88.79 million non-deck fossil-km estimate excludes double-deck blocks and is a cross-check, not this audit's total activity denominator.
The five or so 2023 in-service battery-electric buses are not separately observable in the service-km feed; treating all non-trolley activity as fossil is a small conservative bias.
